info.title: AttendX API
info.description: V2 central identity and faculty synchronization contract. Cookie-authenticated mutations require X-CSRF-Token from sign-in. Login requires X-Requested-With: attendx. Faculty device sync uses scoped Bearer credentials. Student classroom intake runs on a separate hotspot-only HTTPS service, not this central server. V1 mutation/derived-absence paths are disabled by default. Academic administration tools retain their existing /api/admin paths.
